reason: I do the billing myself every month, so I reckon I already know where most of the leakage is. Handing my whole PSA export and client contracts to a one-man outfit with no integrations, no reviews and no customers isn't something I'd do in a normal week, free or not.
objection: It's my client data and my contracts going to someone nobody's heard of. A DPA is just paper if the company folds in six months, and after that I'd be paying £99 a month for something I mostly do in a spreadsheet already.
would_change_my_mind: A couple of MSP owners I know or trust, say from a peer group or forum, telling me it found real money they actually billed, and a direct read-only integration with my PSA so I'm not emailing exports around.
